decision: kept the existing poc/fan-curves-imu-20261001 branch and working changes
why: avoid destroying prior implementation and preserve a direct rollback to 695dcab

decision: will not mutate the printer before baseline backup
why: firmware flashing is a one-way operational action even with A/B recovery

decision: mapped standby fan commands from printer source instead of guessing P ids
why: M106 without P controls main fan; P2 controls cavity_fan; P3 is purifier-gated

decision: added Klipper patch so temp_speed_table can override the stock stepped table
why: original parser rejected the merged section before callback selection

decision: kept Quiet as the first active curve and tested one nozzle at 75C
why: current nozzle fan reached 0.10 while power fan and other nozzle fans stayed 0

decision: confirmed standby fan response and G-code ownership
why: main M106 and cavity P2 respond directly; purifier P3 is power-gated; heater_fan manual speed is overwritten by its callback

decision: rejected direct systemUpgrade.sh execution as the normal upgrade path
why: the lava SSH user cannot write boot partitions or reboot through sysrq

decision: rejected inner update.img for the Firmware Config upload endpoint
why: the page endpoint validates and unwraps a complete UPFILE before invoking the root upgrade service

decision: standardized on uploading the complete U1_extended__upgrade.bin through Firmware Config
why: this is the existing root-owned page path and it wrote uboot_b boot_b and system_b with MD5 verification

decision: accepted Max Speed Balanced and TMC Reduced Current as compatible settings
why: Firmware Config reports both enabled and Klipper reports X/Y run_current 1.0 with max_velocity 600 and max_accel 22000

decision: kept IMU results as structural vibration indicators only
why: e0_lis2dw distinguishes cavity fan vibration but has no acoustic calibration and the main fan remains near the standby floor
